  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail

      properties:
        type:
          title: Type

          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status

          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true

        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'

          readOnly: true

        - message

      title: Specialty

          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true

          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id

    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the
            city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the current server date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth (ISO date). Optional; when supplied the owner's
            ageBand is derived from it relative to the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'

          title: Shares household
          description: >-

          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false

    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted as '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence (one more than the owners already in that city).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registration date year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 fixed at creation. It starts at 1, gains a level when an email address is present and another when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), and is capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived by postcode first (the region whose pinned range contains the postcode - NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), falling back to the city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) when the postcode is absent or in no known range, or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by owners who live in the same household (same last name and address), assigned when an owner joins an existing household via 'sharesHousehold'. Null for owners not in a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'H-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The derived key used for duplicate detection, formatted as 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where the email segment is empty when the owner has no email and the householdId segment is empty when the owner is not in a shared household. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners, at the moment this owner was created, sharing the same first and last name (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:

              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been registered on this owner's registration day, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner is not a hard duplicate but shares an existing owner's last name and postcode with a different telephone number, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: How the owner prefers to be contacted, 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.

              example: 'PHONE'
              readOnly: true

              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.

  - name: owner-v2

  - name: users

  - name: pets

  - name: pet-v2

      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:

        - owners
      operationId: addOwner

      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.

        description: The pet owner

        required: true

            ETag:

              schema:
                type: string
          content:

        304:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be valid for the
            city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the current server date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth (ISO date). Optional; when supplied the owner's
            ageBand is derived from it relative to the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares
            its household (same last name and postcode), declaring it a genuine additional
            member rather than a duplicate. Only bypasses the duplicate block; the household
            link is assigned deterministically regardless. Not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted as '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence (one more than the owners already in that city).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted as '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registration date year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 fixed at creation. It starts at 1, gains a level when an email address is present and another when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), and is capped at 3. Level 4 is reserved for tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived by postcode first (the region whose pinned range contains the postcode - NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), falling back to the city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) when the postcode is absent or in no known range, or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by owners who live in the same household (same last name and address), assigned when an owner joins an existing household via 'sharesHousehold'. Null for owners not in a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'H-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true

`householdId` must become deterministic — the first 12 hex chars of SHA-256 over `normalizedLastName + "|" + postcode` — so owners with the same last name and postcode share it automatically. `sharesHousehold` should only *bypass the duplicate block*, not *create the link*. A second owner in the same household is a `409` unless it declares `sharesHousehold`, in which case it's created as a declared member and **not** flagged as a possible duplicate.

## Changes

**`Households.java`** — Now the single source of household identity. `id(...)` computes the 12-hex SHA-256 over `normalizedLastName + "|" + postcode` (dropped the old address-based key and `H-` prefix). Added `id(Owner)`, `id(OwnerFieldsDto)`, and `sameHousehold(a, b)` helpers. Removed the address normalization, `matches(...)`, and `resolveHouseholdId(...)` that the old opt-in link needed.

**`AssignHousehold.java`** — Reduced to stamping the owner with its deterministic id (`owner.setHouseholdId(Households.id(owner))`). No more repository scan or stamping of existing members — the id is now self-derived, so same-household owners coincide automatically.

**Duplicate block (renamed for the new meaning):**
- Deleted `EnsureUniqueIdentity` / `DuplicateIdentityException` / its handler + escalation yml.
- Added `EnsureUniqueHousehold` — rejects when an existing owner shares the request's computed household id, **unless** `sharesHousehold` is set. Backed by new `HouseholdDuplicateException` → `HouseholdDuplicateExceptionHandler` (409) and its escalation yml. Wired the POST pipeline to the new step.

**`DetectPossibleDuplicate.java`** — A declared member (`sharesHousehold` true) is never flagged; otherwise it consults `PossibleDuplicates`.

**`PossibleDuplicates.java`** — Now keys the soft match off `Households.sameHousehold` + differing telephone (was re-deriving last name/postcode itself).

**`CountHouseholdMembers.java`** — Counts via `Households.sameHousehold`, so the household-size input to membership uses the computed id.

**`IdentityKeys.java`** — Dropped the request-side overload (the old household-resolution path); the `identityKey` response field remains as a derived summary.

**`openapi.yml`** — Updated the `householdId`, `identityKey`, `sharesHousehold`, and `possibleDuplicate` descriptions/examples to match.

The one acceptance test (`coreSameLastNameAndPostcodeShareHouseholdId`) passes: same last name + postcode share an id (owner `b` uses `sharesHousehold` to bypass the 409), and a different last name yields a different id.
